Summarize explicit GEO series from family SOFT metadata, retaining repeated characteristics and provenance

gf_geo_collection_summary.Rd

Summarize explicit GEO series from family SOFT metadata, retaining repeated characteristics and provenance. Reuses the raw SOFT cache. detail=fields (default above 3 series) returns compact characteristic inventories, coverage and up to five example values, without sample rows. characteristic_key is a literal ASCII-case-insensitive key substring; request inss to exclude developmental stage. Fields results retain input order, per-series ok/timed_out/unavailable status and retry_accessions. detail=samples retains repeated characteristics and provenance. Optionally match a treatment term plus explicit caller-supplied aliases and count explicit dataset-local subjects (compact treatment_summary in fields mode; raw evidence and combination flags in samples mode). Samples without subject IDs and protocol-only mentions do not count as subjects. Samples mode returns an immutable collection snapshot (accessions, SOFT source, content SHA-256) and cross-dataset overlap: subjects merge only through a shared GSM. Neither total is a verified unique patient total across datasets. No disease inference, expression load or model normalization.

Usage

gf_geo_collection_summary(
    session,
    `accessions`,
    `characteristic_key` = NULL,
    `detail` = NULL,
    `treatment_aliases` = NULL,
    `treatment_term` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

accessions

(array)

characteristic_key

(string, optional) Literal ASCII-case-insensitive characteristic-key substring, not regex or synonym; e.g. 'inss' matches 'stage [inss]'. NULL omits it.

detail

(string, optional; one of "fields", "samples") Fields is the default for more than 3 series; samples otherwise. Samples preserves the legacy evidence envelope. NULL omits it.

treatment_aliases

(array, optional) Explicit alternative names for treatment_term, matched like the term; requires treatment_term. NULL omits it.

treatment_term

(string, optional) Literal ASCII-case-insensitive substring in treatment-like characteristics and protocols; no automatic synonyms. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the geo_collection_summary tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/geo-collection-summary-result-v1.schema.json.
